text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're rolling out the adaptive-proxy + Swift model family to GA on Hosted API next week. This enables streaming multiplexing and introduces per-tenant concurrency limits by default. Full rollout schedule and opt-in details below. :party_parrot:

kevin: Nice — is this a full GA or a staged rollout? How does fallback behave with older model variants?

maya: It's staged. US regions first, EU after. On overload requests will be routed to a compatible variant (swift-lite) automatically. See internal release notes: https://go.redwood/internal/releases/adaptive-proxy

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary started to prod-us-east-1 at 2026-04-04 15:12 UTC — canary id cp-1978675300 

sam: Will this change default retry semantics for SDKs? We currently treat 429 as backoff. Any header changes to surface limits?

maya: Yes — 429 responses will include Retry-After. New header x-rw-concurrency surfaces live limits. Old clients are forwarded to legacy path for 30 days to reduce breakage. DevX docs: /docs/hosted/adaptive-proxy-retries

kevin: Any canary perf numbers yet? latency and p95 pls.

anika: Quick policy Q — per-tenant concurrency defaults? And how does this affect Dedicated/Private customers?

maya: Defaults: free tier 20 concurrent streams, paid 100. Dedicated customers can request increases via Support; Private deployments can control via their config. Rollout timeline:
- Apr 5: Opt-in preview for all orgs
- Apr 12: US GA
- Apr 19: EU GA
- May 3: Default enablement and start of legacy-toolcall-v1 deprecation (read-only)
- May 31: legacy-toolcall-v1 disabled

sam: Example curl for new streaming/multiplex endpoint:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"swift-1.2","multiplex":true,"streams":2}' \
  https://api.redwo.in/v1/hosted/streaming
```

kevin: Will quotas/billing change? Growth team needs the delta.

maya: Token billing unchanged. Multiplex counts as separate stream units for quota metering. Growth will get a detailed delta export tomorrow. Please ping @growth-team for questions.

devx-bot: devx: new SDK releases published — js@3.5.0 and py@2.9.1 include adaptive-proxy support and updated retry helpers.

sam: If error rates spike, what's the rollback plan?

maya: Rollback path is automatic throttling to legacy pool, then full rollback to previous release within ~15 minutes if required. Ops playbook: https://go.redwood/internal/playbooks/adaptive-rollback

kevin: Ack. I'll coordinate with infra for instance warmup and capacity. :eyes:

maya: Thanks — please add any customer-facing notes in #support before EOD. Will follow up with a one-pager for CSMs. :rocket:
